title: Match-3
description: Swap colorful tiles to make lines of three or more and trigger cascading matches.
instructions: Click or drag adjacent tiles to swap them. Show Moves reveals hints. New Game resets the board.
licenseNotes: The repository LICENSE is MIT, while match3-example.js expressly specifies GPL-3.0-or-later. Both notices are retained. All game visuals are procedural.
modifications: Added a descriptive page title and centered the game on a dark background.
